apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

tender-detail.eventDescription: One tender delivered with its full detail (buyer, budget, dates, documents).

tender-summary.eventDescription: One tender delivered from the listing only (no detail page fetched).

notice-record.eventDescription: One World Bank procurement notice delivered to the dataset.

notice-new.eventDescription: A TED procurement notice never delivered before.

notice-updated.eventDescription: A previously delivered TED notice whose content changed, or one re-sent unchanged by a full-snapshot run.

grant-new.eventDescription: A Regione Lombardia grant call (bando) never delivered before.

grant-updated.eventDescription: A previously delivered grant call whose status or fields changed, or one re-sent unchanged by a full-snapshot run.

watchlist-hit.eventDescription: Charged once for each delivered tender record whose text matches a keyword of the caller's own watchlist. Never charged when no valid keyword was supplied.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Consolidation of single-source Actors into latam-global-tender-intelligence: each legacy source keeps its own per-record price as a separate event, and the start event is set to $0.005.
